ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green cubes, firm with smooth flesh and slightly translucent edges, roughly 1.5 cm cubes, clustered in the upper left of the plate next to the greens | 55
ITEM 2 | Orange-salmon wedges and chunks with slightly netted, rough-textured rind edges and moist, juicy-looking flesh, about 2-3 cm pieces, arranged at top center beside the pale cubes | 70
ITEM 3 | Bright red strawberry halves, glossy and moist with visible seeds on the surface, about 3 cm across, two pieces, one on the center-right and one at lower right | 40
ITEM 4 | Small dark blueberries, glossy with slight bloom, scattered in a cluster across the lower right of the plate, about 1 cm each | 35
ITEM 5 | Mixed green leafy greens with frilly, ruffled edges in light and dark green and some reddish-purple tinged leaves, slightly wilted and moist, covering the left and lower center of the plate | 60
ITEM 6 | Golden yellow corn kernels with some pale tan granular clumps and browned, crisp-looking bits, dry and crumbly, mounded at upper right of the plate | 30
ITEM 7 | Brown, dry, crumbly nut or seed pieces with irregular rough surfaces and some darker toasted spots, mixed in with the corn at the upper right | 15
ITEM 8 | Thin light-brown dressing smears and small wet drips along the upper right rim and a few specks near the greens, glossy and semi-liquid | 5
